# Photo attribution

The weights in this folder were trained on the photographs below: the 11,118 labelled training photos and the 12,126 unlabelled transfer photos, all from [iNaturalist](https://www.inaturalist.org/). Each keeps its own licence (CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC) and is credited here as its licence asks. Validation photos were used only to choose the checkpoint and fit the temperature; test photos were used only to score the finished model. They are not listed.

23,244 photos: 20,404 cc-by-nc, 2,427 cc-by, 413 cc0.
